answer: Each identity locks 60 credits and files a hash commitment for one fresh delivery in the island registry. When the beacon lights, a ten-minute window opens to reveal the preimage as a signed plume. Auditors replay the hash; a late or copied plume burns the bond. First filing 50, the k-th 50+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes burn 2,547,500 plus 60,000 locked for a 40,000 pool; a rented-commitment ring loses. An honest agent pays 50 once and gets its 60 back.
